specialty_focus: Cirúrgica Fernandes is a Brazilian wholesale distributor and importer of medical, hospital, and surgical products, serving hospitals, clinics, and healthcare providers. It specializes in B2B distribution, global sourcing, and importation, with a focus on hospital replenishment and supply chain logistics. While it distributes a wide range of medical devices, it does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
